title: A file's own citations rank first: context() serves the decisions, lessons and references the queried file names by id, above every other tier
acceptance_criteria: a file that names a store id gets that object in its bundle whatever its scope and whatever the task, marked cited, ranked above path-bound items; a directory or unreadable path behaves exactly as before; the usage record counts cited items

title: A compaction ends a session's context cover: an edit after the context window was compacted or cleared needs a context() call made after it
acceptance_criteria: the SessionStart hook records a boundary for a compact or clear; a context() call before the boundary no longer covers an edit after it, and the warning says why; a call after it does; branch-window and agent-session fallbacks obey the same boundary; nugit stats counts resets and never counts a boundary as a call, and is unchanged for sessions that never reset

title: Task words count by how rare they are: within a relevance rank, the record matching the task's rarer words comes first
acceptance_criteria: within one relevance rank, items order by the summed rarity (ln N/df over the loaded store) of the task words they contain, before scope, status and id; tiers, the keyword gate and the caps are unchanged, and nothing is admitted or cut by weight; a task of only ubiquitous words, or no task, orders exactly as before; one tokenization answers both the gate and the weight; measured on the pilot's replay tasks against the shipped ranking
